$comment: Definition of done for the ChemLab gauntlet. Flip passes only with evidence (command output or inspected screenshot). Verify commands / acceptance are not edited to pass.

features.title: Offline-first: zero runtime network fetches
features.acceptance: No gstatic/CDN font or Environment preset fetches; scenes render with network access blocked in the probe.
features.verify: grep -rn 'gstatic\|preset=' src/ returns nothing network-bound; probe run with route-abort on external hosts still renders apparatus

features.title: Titration scene renders and completes
features.acceptance: Probe screenshot shows bench, stand, burette with graduations, flask, tile; scripted titration reaches endpoint with pink flask and correct titre.

features.title: Clock reaction correct + visual
features.acceptance: Turbidity obscures cross over time; time scales inversely with [S2O3]; rate table fills; probe asserts endpoint times for two concentrations.

features.title: Enthalpy experiment correct + visual
features.acceptance: Adding Na2CO3 animates, temperature curve behaves physically, ΔH sign and magnitude match 9701/31/M/J/20 expectations.

features.title: AAA scene look
features.acceptance: Lighting graded (no blown-out bench), real lathe-profile glassware, readable labels, composed camera per experiment. Blind side-by-side vs PhET/Labster shots does not embarrass.
features.verify: probe shots inspected each iteration; verdict logged in notes/progress.md

features.title: No dev artifacts in prod
features.acceptance: No Stats widget, no console errors in probe, lint clean.
features.verify: npm run lint && probe error log empty

features.title: Mobile usable
features.acceptance: 390x844 probe shots show non-overlapping UI, tappable controls, legible text for all three experiments.

features.title: Build + lint green, bundle sane
features.acceptance: npx vite build succeeds; main chunk code-split so first paint isn't blocked by three.js.
